title: Redemption
description: The immutable fact that one discount was actually applied to one order, and what it cost.

discount-id.description: The promo or coupon that was applied, by its base-record id.

source.description: Which concrete discount subtype discount-id addresses. Saves a two-table lookup.

kind.description: Arithmetic branch that was evaluated, captured so an old redemption stays readable.

campaign-id.description: Campaign the cost is charged to.

coupon-code.description: Code as presented, when source is coupon. Absent for a promo.

account-id.description: Account that benefited, opaque here; pseudonymous after erasure.

order-id.description: Order in the shop product the discount was applied to.

amount-off.description: What the discount actually cost, after caps and clamping. Never negative.

redeemed-at.description: Instant the order was placed, not the instant the quote was issued.

reversed-at.description: Set when the order was cancelled or refunded. A reversal never deletes this record.
